verdict.rationale: Gitleaks handles many items in a single invocation: `dir` scans whole directories, `git` scans an entire repo's patch history via `git log -p`, and gitleaks-action can scan all of a team's pull requests and commits. A baseline file also suppresses all previously known findings at once. That is bulk scanning, not general bulk operations, and nothing shows batch actions on findings or scanning many repositories in one run. Missing for 10: bulk actions on findings (triage, ignore, remediate), multi-repo or org-wide batch scanning, and a documented batch API or workflow for agents.
